#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static int mod = 998244353;
static int g = 3;

long long qpow(long long a, long long n) {
    long long x = 1;
    a %= mod;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n & 1) x = x * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return x;
}

void rader(vector<long long>& y, int len) {
    for (int i = 1, j = len / 2; i < len - 1; i++) {
        if (i < j) swap(y[i], y[j]);
        int k = len / 2;
        while (j >= k) { j -= k; k /= 2; }
        if (j < k) j += k;
    }
}

void NTT(vector<long long>& y, int len, int on) {
    rader(y, len);
    for (int h = 2; h <= len; h <<= 1) {
        long long wn = qpow(g, (mod - 1) / h);
        if (on == -1) wn = qpow(wn, mod - 2);
        for (int j = 0; j < len; j += h) {
            long long w = 1;
            for (int k = j; k < j + h / 2; k++) {
                long long u = y[k];
                long long t = w * y[k + h / 2] % mod;
                y[k] = (u + t) % mod;
                y[k + h / 2] = (u - t + mod) % mod;
                w = w * wn % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    if (on == -1) {
        long long t = qpow(len, mod - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
            y[i] = y[i] * t % mod;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int len = 1;
    int nn = n / 2;
    while (len < (9 * nn + 1)) len <<= 1;
    vector<long long> a(len, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        a[x] = 1;
    }
    NTT(a, len, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (a[i] != 0) {
            a[i] = qpow(a[i], nn) % mod;
        }
    }
    NTT(a, len, -1);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        ans = (ans + a[i] * a[i]) % mod;
    }
    cout << (ans + mod) % mod << "\n";
    return 0;
}
